newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS SPOTLIGHT-ANALYSIS OF HINGIS V KOURNIKOVA.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS SPOTLIGHT-ANALYSIS OF HINGIS V KOURNIKOVA.

text.p: Analysis of Saturday's French Open women's singles third round match between top seed Martina Hingis of Switzerland and Russia's Anna Kournikova, won 6-1 6-3 by Hingis.

Hingis won her serve in the opening game, then broke Kournikova to lead 2-0. Hingis took her opponent's serve again to go 5-1 up and served for the set. Kournikova hit a forehand into the net on set point.

Kournikova woke up to win the first game to love but in the third game she hit a backhand into the net on break point to give Hingis a 2-1 lead. Hingis broke the Russian again with a forehand volley to lead 4-1.
Kournikova kept fighting to earn two break points in the eighth game. Hingis hit a backhand wide on the first.
Leading 5-3, Hingis secured two match points in the next game after a couple of clumsy errors by Kournikova. On the first, the Russian hit a straight forward backhand into the net.
